docs.title: ICAP Server: configuring scan timeouts
docs.snippet: The request timeout defines how long ICAP Server waits for a Core scan result before returning an error. Increase it for large archives.

docs.title: Core: archive handling settings
docs.snippet: Limits for nested archives, extracted file count and total extracted size.

docs.title: ICAP Server: supported ICAP clients and preview mode
docs.snippet: Preview mode lets an ICAP client send the first bytes of a file before deciding to send the rest.

jira.title: ICAP: 500 returned on uploads over 50 MB
jira.snippet: Customer reports 500 on large uploads, resolved by raising the request timeout; docs update pending.

confluence.title: Sizing archive scans on Core 5.x
confluence.snippet: Rule of thumb for archive scan duration and recommended ICAP timeouts.

cases.title: CASE-23877: large zip uploads fail via ICAP
cases.snippet: Resolved by increasing the ICAP request timeout to 300s.
